opening.argument: The video promotes paying about $10,000 for a StrongBlock node while presenting “$100 a day completely passive” as the expected opportunity. The creator says that, if viewers have the money, he “strongly recommend[s] looking into this,” calling it “an insane money maker,” and the node requires ten Strong tokens. He recommends buying nodes, says he will buy more, and directly invites viewers to send an Instagram DM if they want him to run a node for them. That makes the income claim an active solicitation, not neutral commentary. The video also promotes a $9-per-month subscription for buy-and-sell alerts tied to these crypto-earning opportunities.
